links.reason: 13:11-14 has the cow (ஓர் ஆ ... நன் பால் ஊட்டி ... புறங்காத்து ஓம்ப) do what the mother who இரங்காள் would not, and 15:17-19 says the dead man, never letting go of தற்காத்து அளித்த தகை ஆ, is born ஆங்கு அவ் ஆ வயிற்று. The later unit fulfils the earlier, and the 'not a cow's son' of 13:19 is answered.

The epic's காரி கதனஞ்சான் பாய்ந்தானைக் காமுறும் (27) matches Kalittokai 104's காரி கதன் அஞ்சான் பாய்ந்த பொதுவற்கே (74) and காரி கதன் அஞ்சான் கொள்பவன் (21), a run of the formula plus the verb பாய். In the Kalittokai the kin give the girl (எமர் கொடை நேர்ந்தார், 75) after a real contest; in the kuravai the formula only names a dancer, so the development and both gains hold.

205 lists பெண்கொடுத்தான் ... மகக்கொடுத்தான் among the proofs of giving; 565 answers that women are not உறுபொருள் for alms and that those who take them cannot be shown not to be கள்ளர், with the children wailing (பிள்ளைகள் ஏங்க). The later verse answers the earlier from a new side, the receiver's, and the note keeps the refuted view with Kundalakesi.

20:123-126 says ஊழ்வினை took the prince's life yet Kanchanan's வெவ் வினை நின்னையும் அகலாது; 21:66 says மறம் செய்துளது எனின் வல் வினை ஒழியாது and 70-71 that this deed came and harmed the husband. The same deity explains the killing from both ends, so the 'chain' in which each ripening is a new accountable wrong is in the Tamil.
links.text_issue: 21:61-62 and 67-69 are compressed; the link rests on 66 and 70-71, which are clear.

links.reason: 22:193-203 makes the prince's தீவினை the subject that brings him and the vidyadhara together and எறிந்தது, while 20:125-126 tells the killer his own வெவ் வினை will cling to him. The second telling, to the father, drops the killer's liability, so the audience-shaped difference is real and the note is accurate.

121 says வரிசை அறிதலோ அரிதே and asks the patron to give up பொது நோக்கு; 140 praises a giver who, வரிசை அறிதலின் தன்னும் தூக்கி, answered a request for rice with an elephant. The shared term is used on the recipient's rank in one and on the giver's own in the other, which is what teaches says.

The lists are accurately reported: 119 counts நினைவு, மீட்டுணர்வு, ஊகம், அனுமை and the sages' ஆகமம; Manimekalai 27:41-56 has உவமம், ஆகமம், அருத்தாபத்தி, ஐதிகம், அபாவம் and the rest. But neither limits or conditions the other; two schools give incompatible counts of the means of knowledge, which is a tension, not a qualification.

Saathan's செய்தவம் இல்லோர்க்குத் தேவர் வரம்கொடார் (17) shares the word செய்தவம் with Kural 265 and states its converse, and at 24-28 he gives Maalathi back a child by becoming it. The pairing is real but thin: the couplet says only that tapas gets what is wished, and the 'override' is a substitution rather than a boon granted, so the teaching needs a generous reading.

499:4 asks whether anything is ever made clear except குணமுகத்தால், to show a soul exists; 802:1-2 asks how a quality அதற்கு அயலது can be called இதனது குணம், against a substance apart from its qualities. The same guna principle is turned against two opponents to opposite effect, as teaches says.
links.text_issue: 802:3-4 (உதனமு) is obscure; the link rests on lines 1-2.

links.reason: The goddess's chain கோல் நிலை திரிந்திடின் கோள் நிலை திரியும் ... மாரி வறம் கூரும் (8-9) is Kural 559's முறைகோடி மன்னவன் ... ஒல்லாது வானம் பெயல் with the planets added, and she aims it at அவத் திறம் set on one who has taken up tapas (13-14), said to an heir who has judged no case. That is a case the couplet does not foresee, so the qualification and both gains hold.

Kannaki's refrain துன்புறு வனநோற்றுத் துயருறு மகளிரைப்போல் ... அழிவலோ (35-37, 43-45) rejects the observances of கைம்மை that Purananuru 246:4-10 lists (no ghee, அடைஇடைக் கிடந்த கைபிழி பிண்டம், the பரற்பெய் பள்ளி). The queen chooses the fire (தீயும் ஓரற்றே), Kannaki turns to the sun (காய்கதிர்ச் செல்வனே கள்வனோ என்கணவன், 51), so the contrast in teaches is in the text.
links.text_issue: The marker flags the sense of 41 (அறனென்னும் மடவோய்); the link does not rest on it.

links.reason: Purananuru 34 grants கழுவாய் for three wrongs and none for ingratitude; Neelakesi 148 asks a பிராயச்சித்தம் and is told to make the Jina's path clear (சினவரன் நெறியே தெருட்டு). The two share only the topic of expiation; 'lifelong' is not in 148, and the Puram poem's list gains nothing, since 148 neither adds to nor tests it.

Aravanar's பிறந்தோர் உறுவது பெருகிய துன்பம் ... பற்றின் வருவது (64-66) and Tirumanthiram 432's இன்பப் பிறவி படைத்த இறைவனும் துன்பஞ்செய் பாசத் துயருள் அடைத்தனன் do differ on whether a maker lays the bond. But both hold that embodied birth is now bound in suffering, so the conflict 'about birth itself' is narrower than teaches puts it and rests on one uncertain reading of 432.
links.text_issue: Tirumanthiram 432 is flagged uncertain; the variant அடைந்தனன் would change its sense.

links.reason: 302:8 நோக்கினர்ச் செகுக்கும் காளை and 303:3 எள்ளுநர்ச் செகுக்கும் காளை share a three-word frame with one slot changed, in two poems of the same thurai. Teaches states exactly that; the shared item is a formula rather than an image, but the pairing teaches something real.

Neelakesi 141 has the sage in the சுடுகாடு himself uproot his karma (பல்வினையும் பறிப்போய்), while Tirumanthiram 1616 has Siva, who dwells in காட்டகம், be the one who பிறவி அறுத்திடும் for renouncers. That is the incompatible claim the brief names, release by the soul's own wearing away of karma against release by the god, and the note states the reading it depends on.

Chithirapathi's பண் தேர் மொழியின் பயன் பல வாங்கி வண்டின் துறக்கும் கொண்டி மகளிர் (108-109) is the type of Kural 912's பயன்தூக்கிப் பண்புரைக்கும் மகளிர், but she draws from it பான்மையின் பிணித்து ... கோன்முறை (110-111), seizure, not avoidance, and applies it to a girl who has taken the bowl. The note keeps this as her view, and the reversal is specific.

The unit gives the bhuta's Brahmin marks, and only 34-35 (முத்தீ வாழ்க்கை முறைமையின் வழாஅ வேத முதல்வன்) are among the kept lines; the departure 'because the king erred' is not in the unit. Tirumanthiram 234 (rites keep the land and king) and the epic (a wronged city loses its guardian) can both be true at once, so this is a limit on the rule, not an incompatible claim.
links.text_issue: Lines 17-33 are marked in the edition as doubtful; the departure the note relies on is outside the unit.

links.reason: The cry அறவோர் உளீரோ? ஆரும் இலோம் (56) answered by the monk who speaks அன்புடன் அளைஇய அருள்மொழி (63) does fit Kural 30's அந்தணர் என்போர் அறவோர் ... செந்தண்மை. But the Brahmins do not fail the dying man in this unit (43 says only that Sudhamathi was unfit for them), and the title மறையோன் at 68 lies outside it, so teaches needs a generous reading.

Aravanar defines பேதைமை as forgetting what is seen and முயற்கோடு உண்டு எனக் கேட்டது தெளிதல் (113-114), a plain case of Kural 351's பொருளல்லவற்றைப் பொருளென்று உணரும் மருள், and puts it at the head of the twelve links that end in birth (105-108). The couplet's one step from error to மாணாப் பிறப்பு becomes a chain, as teaches says.

The half-line is shared (காதலர்ப் பிரிந்த மாதர் நோதக / காதலர்ப் பிரிந்த புலம்பின் நோதக). The furnace is not: Silappathikaram's ஊதுஉலைக் குருகின் is a smith's bellows, but Akananuru 71:13-14 (எள்அற இயற்றிய அழல்காண் மண்டிலத்து உள்ஊது ஆவியின் பைப்பய நுணுகி) is breath on a polished disc slowly fading. 'Nearly verbatim' overstates one half-line.

Verse 7 defends the work because people take புள்ளின் உரையும் as meaningful, and 885 counts புட்குரல் among things the elements cannot explain. That is a recurring appeal to the same belief, not a later verse answering or fulfilling an earlier one.
links.text_issue: Verse 7 line 1 is obscure, and the verse is flagged uncertain.

links.reason: The note is accurate: 177's உரு, உழப்பு, அறிவு, குறி, செய்கை match Manimekalai 30:189-190's உருவு நுகர்ச்சி குறிப்பே பாவனை உள்ள அறிவு, apart from two names. But the claim that உழப்பு and the flame-tip (எரிநுதிபோல்) 'load' the list toward attack is not shown by the verse; momentariness is the Buddhists' own doctrine, so the pair mainly agrees.

Both poems use Kolli as a figure of lasting: 338 has கொல்லி போலத் தவாஅலியரே நட்பே, and 209 has the hill Kaari gave to the Cheras after killing Ori, with its நிலைபெறு ... பாவை. Teaches claims 338 makes the hill and not its house lasting, but 338 calls it the Porai's Kolli, and the shared figure is better called same_image.

Visakai points to grey hair (நாறு ஐங் கூந்தலும் நரை விராவுற்றன, 130) and the passing of youth (இளமையும் நில்லாது, 135), the quatrain's premise, but turns him to தானம் செய் (139), and the two do their charity together. Naladiyar 11 offers only early renunciation or the staff of age, so this third course is a real qualification.

கொற்றவன் கோடி (60) shares the bending of Kural 559's முறைகோடி மன்னவன். But in the epic it is a simile for the summer waste (வேத்தியல் இழந்த வியனிலம் போல), not the couplet's causal claim, and the foreshadowing of Madurai is the reader's inference, so the link needs a generous reading.

The scene of a wife by a wounded chest at night is shared (மார்பிற் புண்ணும், Puram 280:1; புண்தாழ் குருதி, 37), but it is a common topos. Kannaki's lament also holds the deed (உண்பதோர் வினை, கடுவினை யுடையேன்) beside the king's fault, so 'a charge against the king' simplifies it.
links.text_issue: The marker flags both units as uncertain in sense.

links.reason: The song asks தவமென்னை கொல்லோ of the girl and gives the credit to விற்றொழில் வேடர் குலனே குலனும் (90), and Kural 972 ties distinction to செய்தொழில். That the clan's boast is 'the move the couplet's rule forbids' is contestable: the song credits the clan through a deed, and the bow-work is itself a தொழில். The pairing is real but needs a generous reading.

723:1 follows Kural 948's order (நோய், நோய்முதல் நாடி, மருந்து) and applies it to the teacher, which is a fair development. But the disease the teachers cure is the suffering of பல்லுயிர்க்கும், not a rival doctrine, so the teaches clause about diagnosing a doctrine and the gains clause about checking 'her diagnosis of the Ajivika' are not in the verse.

The demons hail the king as அறக்களஞ் செய்தோன் (26:246) over the slaughter, and Maadalan tells him அறக்கள வேள்வி செய்யாது ... மறக்கள வேள்வி செய்வோ யாயினை (28:131-132). The same pair of words is set to opposite verdicts in a later kaathai that answers the earlier praise, which is a sound tension.
links.text_issue: 26:225-246 is flagged uncertain in sense; the link rests on line 246, which is plain.

links.reason: Kural 661 says only that வினைத்திட்பம் is மனத்திட்பம் and that மற்றைய எல்லாம் பிற; nothing in it names 381's six assets. The link depends on Parimelazhagar's gloss of 'the others', which is commentary, and teaches states a moral neither couplet makes.

The book opens with திங்களைப் போற்றுதும் ... ஞாயிறு போற்றுதும் ... பூம்புகார் போற்றுதும், each praised for being like the Chola (குடைபோன்று, திகிரிபோல், அவன்குலத்தொடு), and closes wishing Puhar to live like the morning கதிரவன் and the evening மதியம், with no king in the comparison. The frame and the shift teaches names are in the Tamil.

குறமகள் அவளெம குலமகள் (87) is the clan's claim on the god's wife, and Thiruppugazh 1000 has வேடர் செழுந்தினை காத்து இதண் மீதிலிருந்த பிராட்டி. But the song makes praise of that valour the poet's hoped-for அருந்தவம், not a 'model of the god's grace to the devotee', and the epic-side gain is only that a later poem exists.
links.text_issue: Thiruppugazh 1000 is flagged uncertain in its syntax.

links.reason: Tirumanthiram 243 binds the king to protect ஆவையும் ... அறவோரையும் on pain of hell; in the burning city the fire spares அறவோர் மருங்கின் (113) and கறவையும் கன்றும் கனலெரி சேரா (115). The two share the words and the protected classes, and the epic gives that protection to the pathini's fire in this life, which is the qualification claimed.
links.text_issue: 113 (விடாது) is read as sparing; the marker flags the alternative. Line 111 is doubted in the edition.

links.reason: The vanjinam link is real: the kaathai is வஞ்சின மாலை, and Puram 72 is வஞ்சினக் காஞ்சி (அகப்படேஎன் ஆயின் ... கோலேன் ஆகுக). But Kannaki's vow is not the 'if I do not, may I' form: it is பத்தினியே யாமாகில் ஒட்டேன் அரசோடு (36-37), a vow conditioned on her virtue. The other-side gain, that Puram 72's penalty 'could be fulfilled by another's vow', joins two different kings.

201 argues that something of the first moment must run through the next, like the thread in a garland (பெருந்தாமத்து உண்ணூல்போல்), for knowing to be possible; 419 says the soul's உண்மை stays through austerity and its birth as an இமையான். The continuity argued within a life is extended across births, as teaches says.

Neelakesi 99 says that for the burning sufferers in hell பரிபவரும் இல்லையே; the Murugan song asks the god to come when Death would drop the poet into the seven hells, so that his sins go. One speaks of beings already in hell, the other asks for rescue before the fall, so 'whether anyone can stand between a sinner's deeds and hell' stretches 99.
links.text_issue: Thiruppugazh 1244 has several corrupt words and is flagged uncertain.

links.reason: The epic's couple appear like அருந்தவம் முடித்தோர் born in உத்தர குரு (9-10), and Kural 1103 asks whether தாமரைக் கண்ணான் உலகு is sweeter than the beloved's arms. The contrast between love set above heaven and love as heaven's wage is fair, but 'something that can be used up' is not in the unit; it is the reader's inference from Uttarakuru.

The patikam's ஊழ்வினை உருத்துவந்து ஊட்டும் (57) and சூழ்வினைச் சிலம்பு (58) answer Kural 380's ஊழிற் பெருவலி ... மற்றொன்று சூழினும் தான்முந் துறும். The anklet stands for the devising that fate outruns, and the epic adds the wrath and the feeding (உருத்து, ஊட்டும்), as teaches says.
links.text_issue: The marker flags uncertainty about who speaks 55-60; the link does not depend on it.

links.reason: The parentage matches (Silappathikaram 29:2-3 சேரலாதற்கு ... சோழன்மகளீன்ற மைந்தன்; Patitruppattu patikam 5:2-3 நெடுஞ்சேரலாதற்குச் சோழன் மணக்கிள்ளி ஈன்ற மகன்), as do the stone and the Ganga bathing (கடவுள் பத்தினிக் கற்கோள் வேண்டி ... கங்கை மண்ணி). So the identification rests on the Tamil, not on a name. The epic adds the Aryan kings' taunt and the stone borne on their heads.
links.text_issue: 'Already knew' assumes the patikam is earlier than the epic, which the texts do not settle.

links.reason: Kural 256 makes the eating world the cause of the killing (தினற்பொருட்டால் கொல்லாது உலகெனின்). Neelakesi 347 makes the same demand argument (துறந்தொழிந்தால் கொலை துன்னினர் யாரோ, 4) and adds that whatever is taught as அறம் is taken up (அறஞ் சொல்லக் கொள்ளும்), so responsibility reaches the teacher. Both gains are specific.

Neelakesi 299 argues that if only கருத்து and கண்கூடு counted there could be no மருத்துநூல், and Kural 941 states the three humours as நூலோர் counted them. The pairing illustrates text-borne knowledge, but the claim that the couplet's நூலோர் 'carries a view of knowledge' a rival school denied overreads a passing attribution.

Kural 1102 says பிணிக்கு மருந்து பிறமன், but this woman is herself the cure (தன்நோய்க்குத் தானே மருந்து). The vari gives the sickness to her face and eyes (வாள்முகத்து நேர்க்கயல்கண் செய்த ... உய்யாநோய்) and the cure to her breasts (மென்முலையே தீர்க்கும் போலும்). The paradox is split across the body as teaches says.
links.text_issue: The marker flags 75 (தீர்க்கும் போலும்) as hope or supposition; either way the split holds.

links.reason: Kural 275's பற்றற்றேம் என்பார் படிற்றொழுக்கம் ... ஏதம் பலவுந் தரும் is matched by 258's பற்றே மிகப்பெருக்கி ... அற்றீர் போற் காட்டி. 258 names the evils as பேயுடம்பு or being dragged into இருள்நரகு. The couplet's unnamed ஏதம் is given a rebirth, which is specific.

claims.gist: kings who take up the dharma of compassion need nothing else to remove faults
dharma is nothing other than food, clothing and shelter for all living beings

claims_rejected.why: the king's gratitude, not a claim

claims.gist: name-and-form is the life and body that depend on consciousness
contact is the meeting of mind and sense-gates with their objects
becoming is the accumulation of karma
birth is the arising of the mind joined by karma in the states of being
